# Autocuts

> Autocuts is a local-first Mac screen recorder with automatic click zoom, smooth cursor motion, screen and camera layouts, a voice-paced teleprompter, on-device captions, and a built-in motion studio. It is designed for product demos, tutorials, developer walkthroughs, courses, and launch videos.

Autocuts records a display, app window, or selected area with optional camera, microphone, and system audio. It keeps recordings and project data inside the app on the user's Mac. Editing and export run in the desktop app. The first transcription can download a speech model; after the model is available, transcription runs on the Mac.

Autocuts is built for Apple Silicon Macs, with macOS Sonoma 14 or later recommended. A user can record and retain a video before buying. Processing, transcription, raw-file access, and export require a $34.99 lifetime license for one person on up to two Macs. Lifetime updates are included and there is no subscription.

## Product features

- [Automatic zoom](https://autocuts.ai/features/mac-screen-recorder-with-auto-zoom/): Generate editable zooms from recorded clicks
- [Screen and camera recording](https://autocuts.ai/features/screen-and-camera-recorder-for-mac/): Capture a display, window, or area with webcam, microphone, and system audio
- [Built-in teleprompter](https://autocuts.ai/features/screen-recorder-with-teleprompter/): Voice-paced script with word highlighting that stays outside the recording
- [Local recording](https://autocuts.ai/features/local-screen-recorder-for-mac/): Local files, editing, transcription, and export details
- [Transcript cleanup](https://autocuts.ai/features/transcript-video-cleanup/): On-device transcript navigation, filler-word cleanup, captions, SRT, and VTT
- [No-subscription recorder](https://autocuts.ai/mac-screen-recorder-no-subscription/): One-time $34.99 lifetime license, trial behavior, and refund window

## Current technical facts

- Platform: macOS desktop app built for Apple Silicon
- Recommended system: macOS Sonoma 14 or later
- Capture: display, window, or selected area; camera; microphone; system audio
- Editing: trim, split, speed, zooms, cursor, layouts, backgrounds, transcript, and captions
- Export: MP4 H.264 or WebM VP9, up to 4K at 60 fps; optional SRT and VTT files
- Storage: local Autocuts folder inside the Mac Videos directory
- Account: no app account in the current build
- Analytics: no third-party desktop-app analytics in the current build
